# Never give the operator phases or roadmaps

Operator 2026-09-29: "Never give me phase or roadmaps." Plans go out as options, stack, recommendation, open decisions and the next action. No phases, timelines or roadmap sections. This applies to every project and every planning output, including subagent and workflow prompts.
